title: Deciphering molecular composition and summarizing control strategies of unknown disinfection by-products in water and wastewater based on FT-ICR-MS analysis: a comprehensive review
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00889H, Critical Review
Changmin Wang, Bingliang Zhang, Youzhuang Rong, Xifeng Shi, Yunyan Liu
This review systemically summarizes the molecular composition and characteristics and control strategies of unknown DBPs in water and wastewater based on FT-ICR-MS analysis.
